descriptions.d24l_key_button_borders_802c6434: Builds a keyboard button's borders: loads 'FE.K.BtnBdr' and 'FE.K.BtnBdrH' with the same type byte (base+31) through handles built from the names, stores the cast meshes retained at +48 and +52, scales both to half the button size (+72,+76), attaches them to the panel +28 and sets the ready flag +36.
